threat_event: Attacker takes over a contractor agent's mailbox and sends a buyer altered closing wire instructions that appear to come from the title company; the buyer wires closing funds to the attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 22 agent mailboxes use a password only; legacy protocols enabled; no alerts on new forwarding rules; agents forward wire instructions by email; buyers not told how instructions will arrive
existing_controls: Wire fraud warning in the contract packet; employee MFA; spam filtering
treatment_plan: MFA for every account and legacy protocols blocked; alerts on forwarding rules and risky sign-ins; external forwarding blocked; instructions shared only through SYS-01 client document sharing; buyers told at contract and again a week before closing to call a known number before sending money; agent training with a wire fraud module

threat_event: The brokerage wires a held earnest money deposit from the sales escrow account to a fraudulent account after a spoofed or compromised email from the title company
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Outgoing escrow wires are set up from emailed instructions with no callback; the May 2026 near miss was not recorded and no rule changed
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 475.25(1)(d)1. and (1)(k); Fla. Admin. Code r. 61J2-14.010(1)
existing_controls: Dual control in online banking (Office Manager initiates; Broker-owner approves)
treatment_plan: Written payment instruction verification rule (POL-03 4.9): every new or changed instruction confirmed by a call to the title company's number from the contract file or its published number; approver checks the callback record before approving; bank fraud desk number on the contact card

threat_event: A spoofed owner email changes a property owner's payout bank account and diverts a monthly distribution from the property management escrow account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner bank changes accepted by email and processed by the Property Manager without a callback
existing_controls: Dual control on ACH batches (the approver sees totals, not account changes)
treatment_plan: Bank changes accepted only through the owner portal or on a signed form, confirmed by a call to the owner's number on file; 10-day hold on the first distribution to a new account

threat_event: Look-alike domains imitate the brokerage or a title company to send fraudulent instructions to clients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Domain DMARC policy is monitor only; nobody reads DMARC reports; no look-alike domain watch
existing_controls: External-sender banner; spam filtering
treatment_plan: Move DMARC to quarantine, then reject; MSP reviews reports monthly; client warning names the brokerage's real domain; annual look-alike check

threat_event: Password spraying or credential phishing against agent accounts leads to bulk download of transaction files (driver license images, bank statements)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agents have no MFA; office-wide visibility in SYS-01 lets one account reach every file; no download alerts
existing_controls: Vendor lockout after failed sign-ins
treatment_plan: MFA for agents (R-001 treatment); limit agents to their own files; monthly download report review

threat_event: An attacker obtains the shared global administrator password and takes control of the whole email tenant (reads every mailbox, adds forwarding rules, disables logging)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared administrator account without MFA, password unchanged since 2023 and known to two people, used for routine work
existing_controls: Strong password; account not used for email
treatment_plan: Two named administrator accounts (Office Manager, MSP) with MFA; shared account disabled; break-glass account sealed with the Broker-owner

threat_event: Ransomware delivered by phishing encrypts company devices and synced shared files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing training; antivirus alerts in business hours only; shared files synced to devices
existing_controls: MSP patching and antivirus; laptops carry little local data
treatment_plan: Training and phishing simulations (R-001); MSP-managed behavior-based detection at the next contract renewal; backup scope and tests (R-008)

threat_event: Deleted or attacker-altered mail and files cannot be restored
threat_source: Equipment or software error; attacker deletion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-09 covers employee mailboxes only and has never been restore-tested; agent mailboxes and SYS-01 files have no independent copy
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 475.5015; Fla. Admin. Code r. 61J2-14.012(1)
existing_controls: Vendor platform backups; 30 days of employee copies
treatment_plan: Extend backup to all 29 mailboxes; monthly export of active SYS-01 files; first restore test by 2026-09-30, then quarterly

threat_event: A contractor agent who moves to another brokerage keeps access and takes client files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No offboarding checklist; removal up to two weeks late (an agent was still active 13 days after leaving)
existing_controls: Office Manager removes accounts when told
treatment_plan: Same-day offboarding checklist triggered by the license transfer notice; monthly reconciliation of user lists against the agent roster; contract duty to return or delete client files

threat_event: Loss or theft of an agent's personal phone or laptop with cached email, contracts, and ID images
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Personal devices not managed; no rule to report loss; no way to wipe company mail
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-02 C.3 device rules; app-level protection for the email app with remote wipe of company data; report loss within 1 hour

threat_event: Theft of the unencrypted scanning workstation exposes stored scans of IDs and bank statements
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Desktops unencrypted; scans kept locally
existing_controls: Locked suite; after-hours alarm
treatment_plan: Full-disk encryption on both desktops; scans saved straight to SYS-02 and deleted locally each day

threat_event: Someone in the office after hours reads or removes paper client files from the unlocked storage closet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Closet has no lock; 2016 to 2020 files never purged
existing_controls: Alarm after hours; crew under the landlord's contract
treatment_plan: Lock the closet; shred files past the 5-year retention period (Fla. Stat. 475.5015)

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management tool or backup login gives an attacker control of every company device or deletes the backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP security practices unknown; no MFA evidence; no incident notice or recovery terms in the contract
existing_controls: MSP is an established local firm
treatment_plan: Annual MSP security questionnaire with evidence; contract amendment for MFA, 24-hour incident notice, recovery time, and subcontractor list

threat_event: A SaaS vendor (screening provider, property management platform, transaction platform) is breached and exposes client data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vendor inventory; standard terms only; screening provider and property management platform never reviewed
existing_controls: Transaction platform SOC 2 report reviewed 2026-08-19
treatment_plan: Vendor list with data held; annual review of SOC reports or questionnaires; breach notice terms at renewal

threat_event: After an incident the brokerage misses the Florida 30-day breach notice or the 15-business-day escrow dispute notice to the Commission
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident response plan before 2026-09; no record of the May 2026 near miss; nobody knew the deadlines
existing_controls: Cyber insurer hotline in the policy
treatment_plan: P08 runbook and notification matrix (approved 2026-09-14); tabletop with the MSP; contact card printed

threat_event: Tenant screening recommendations produce unjustified disparate denials by race, national origin, disability, or familial status
threat_source: Vendor screening model and the brokerage's criteria
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recommendation used as the decision; criteria not written; eviction filings and old criminal records counted; vendor documentation never requested
existing_controls: Leasing staff can override (4 times in 12 months)
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: written criteria reviewed by counsel; human review of every decline and conditional approval; individualized review of records; annual criteria and outcome review

threat_event: An applicant gets a higher deposit based on a screening report without the FCRA adverse action notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notices sent only for declines, not for conditional approvals (58 in 12 months)
existing_controls: Platform sends a notice when the decline button is used
treatment_plan: Adverse action notice for every conditional approval; template reviewed by counsel

threat_event: Staff or agents paste client financial details into a consumer generative AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consumer AI tools in use with no rule; about 9 client emails pasted since March 2026
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-04 4.6: no Restricted information in any AI tool, and Internal information only in an approved business plan with no-training terms; training

threat_event: Client data kept long past its business need is exposed in a breach, raising notice counts and harm
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention schedule; files, ID images, and screening reports kept indefinitely
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Retention schedule in POL-04 4.8; annual purge each January

threat_event: Transaction platform outage during a busy closing week
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No company-held export of active files
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 states RTO 4 h and RPO 1 h
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Broker-owner on 2026-09-14: vendor commitments meet the BIA; the monthly export in R-008 adds a fallback

threat_event: Office internet outage on a closing day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One internet line
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 475.25(1)(k) (deposit deadlines continue during an outage)
existing_controls: Staff can work from phone hotspots and home on laptops
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Office Manager on 2026-09-14 (Low): every service is SaaS and reachable from anywhere

threat_event: A hurricane closes the office for several days during active closings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Coastal county; no written plan for working remotely or for escrow deposits while closed
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 475.25(1)(k); Fla. Admin. Code r. 61J2-14.008(3)
existing_controls: Laptops; SaaS systems; 2024 storm closure handled by working from home
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist in the contingency plan: mobile deposit for escrow checks, contact card at home, laptops taken home when a watch is issued

threat_event: The Broker-owner is unavailable on a closing day, so a held deposit or owner distribution cannot be released
threat_source: Illness, travel, or a lost phone
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broker-owner is the only approver; approval codes go to one phone
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 475.25(1)(d)1.; Fla. Admin. Code r. 61J2-14.010(1)
existing_controls: Broker-owner usually reachable by phone
treatment_plan: Hardware token as a second approval device kept in the office safe; written arrangement with the bank for incapacity; standby arrangement with a broker at another firm

threat_event: An attacker hijacks an online banking session (for example by a phone number transfer) and sends a wire from an escrow account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Text-message codes at sign-in and approval
existing_controls: Dual control; bank fraud monitoring
treatment_plan: Ask the bank for app-based or hardware token approval; carrier account PIN on the Broker-owner's phone

threat_event: Agent mailboxes silently forward all client email to personal webmail accounts outside the brokerage's control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: External auto-forwarding allowed; no alerts; found in 3 mailboxes on 2026-08-18
existing_controls: None before 2026-08-19
treatment_plan: Rules removed 2026-08-19; external forwarding blocked at the tenant level; alert on any new forwarding rule
